purpose: One organic declared-output IRQ case consumed by the fixed ISR in a real native session, joined from a pc/insn/order-only CPU.
case_note: ZipTimer has one declared 4-byte COUNT window at offset 0 and no address bits. The CPU is cv32e40p_rvfi_local: only rvfi_valid/order/insn/pc_rdata are driven, so the handler path is joined by documented order and intr/pc_wdata/mem_*/serial stay unobserved.
